d: We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Fleet Sales Executive to develop our commercial vehicle business in Qatar.

The successful candidate will be responsible for visiting businesses and organizations that require commercial vehicles, identifying potential customers, developing new business opportunities, and securing fleet sales agreements.

Develop new corporate and fleet customer accounts.
Target construction companies, contractors, logistics companies, transportation businesses, and other potential commercial vehicle users.
Present vehicle models, prepare quotations, and negotiate commercial offers.
Follow up on leads and convert business opportunities into sales.
Maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.

2–3 years of proven automotive fleet sales experience in Qatar is mandatory.
Strong knowledge of Qatar's automotive and commercial vehicle market.
Proven ability to develop corporate accounts and secure fleet sales deals.
Existing relationships with businesses, contractors, logistics companies, and fleet operators are an advantage.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer relationship skills.

Fluent English and Georgian (both written and spoken);
Experience managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously;
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with frequently changing priorities;
Experience with project management tools (Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or similar) is an advantage;
Previous experience coordinating cross-functional projects is a plus.

Own project timelines, priorities, and execution across multiple teams;

Adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs while keeping projects on track.
